Small details such as fingers, polka dots, fruit, coins, railings, tiles, cobbles and fur edges are drawn precisely with that same clean line. Light parallel hatching only in hair strands, wood grain and deep shadows. Coloring: smooth, nearly flat, transparent watercolor fills inside the outlines, soft shading, white paper left for highlights; no brush streaks, no fabric striations, no grain or mottled texture on clothes, ground, sand or sky. Colors soft and slightly muted. Palette: cobalt blue, bottle green, terracotta, honey-brown wood, cream white, soft teal sea, pale blue sky with white clouds. Soft diffuse light through white fog, gentle shadows, the colours slightly muted by the mist but the outlines clean. Realistic adult proportions and faces, small natural features. Background in the same clean line with paler washes. 16:9, eye-level view, the story object large and clear in the foreground. The characters' faces and hair must match the character sheet (the second image) exactly: row 5 is Tiago; row 1 is Rita. Same face shape, features, age and hair as in those tiles; ignore the clothes, caps, helmets and visors in the tiles (ignore the dog tiles: there is no dog in this picture). Rui is the man in the third image: exactly the same face, hair, age and clothes. Tiago: Portuguese man, about 30, curly black hair, short black beard, big friendly grin; a fitted long-sleeve mountain-bike jersey, dark grey baggy mountain-bike shorts over black knee pads, black full-finger gloves, dark flat-soled trail shoes and a red open-face bike helmet; his jersey is light grey. Rui: Portuguese man about 35, lean and wiry, a narrow tanned face, clean-shaven, light-brown eyes, short neat dark-brown hair going slightly grey at the temples, small smile lines, an easy confident smile; a PE teacher who guides mountain-bike rides; a fitted long-sleeve mountain-bike jersey, dark grey baggy mountain-bike shorts over black knee pads, black full-finger gloves, dark flat-soled trail shoes and a dark grey open-face bike helmet; his jersey is forest green. Rita: Portuguese woman, early 30s, youthful oval face with a soft rounded chin, small straight nose, warm brown eyes, natural brows, rosy cheeks, smooth skin, small gentle closed-mouth smile; straight glossy dark-brown hair just past the shoulders with full blunt bangs to the eyebrows; light olive skin; a fitted long-sleeve mountain-bike jersey, dark grey baggy mountain-bike shorts over black knee pads, black full-finger gloves, dark flat-soled trail shoes and a white open-face bike helmet; her bangs and dark hair visible under the helmet; her jersey is terracotta red. The mountain bikes are all the same model: modern matte-black hardtail mountain bikes with front suspension forks, wide knobbly tyres and flat handlebars. Scene: A forest track at the bottom of the last descent below Fanal, tall laurel trees and ferns, light fog. Tiago kneels on the track beside his bike, which stands upside down on its saddle and handlebar with the front wheel taken off; he holds the front wheel, with its new inner tube fitted, between his knees and pumps up the tyre with a small black hand pump, fast and expert. Rui (exactly the man in the third image) stands next to him with his bike, watching, arms crossed, amused and impressed; Rita (with dried mud on her legs) watches over Tiago's shoulder. The wheel, the tyre and the small pump large and clear in the foreground. No text.
